development.dev_mirror: fast-forward after every accepted main change while dev is retained

cross_lane_rule.stable_origin: Implement the smallest correction on release/4.0, then immediately forward-port the intent and regression proof to main.
cross_lane_rule.development_origin: Implement on main, then backport only when the defect reproduces against the exact maintained 4.0 target and the smaller patch remains valid.

release_rule.trigger: Publish 4.0.x only for an admitted player, security, migration, or exact compatibility correction.
